## Intent Keep durable docs and onboarding copy in the present tense so they describe how Kody works today, not a pending rollout or yesterday's flake. ## Why Yesterday's Muse onboarding path (`#2579`) still narrated a submitted connector "pending review." Startup-budget leftover changelog phrasing and a missing `webhookSyntheticDispatch` architecture note were the same leftover class after `#2587` / `#2594` / `#2595`. ## Summary - Muse host notes and Get started copy now say Muse's directory does not list a Kody connector and point at the Kody CLI. - Startup-budget describes the slim preview entry without the old flake story. - Architecture webhooks and the usage index name `webhookSyntheticDispatch` and link `guide:agent_guidance`. ## Testing - `npm run validate:fix` - `npm run docs:check-temporal` passed - `npm run mermaid:check` passed - `CI=1 npx vitest run --project node-unit packages/worker/client/routes/onboarding-mcp-client-tabs.node.test.ts` passed (asserts CLI path, rejects "pending review") - Pre-commit typecheck + migrations:check passed - Pre-push `test:node` (3517) and `test:workers` (378) passed ## System changes
System recap — composes existing primitives (low risk) **Mode:** recap · **Base:** `main` @ `bd31f2be` · **Head:** `027058e7` **Classification:** composes — present-tense copy on existing onboarding UI and docs. No primitive behavior, schema, or contract change. ### Primitives touched | Primitive | Group | Impact | | --------- | ----- | ------ | | `app-ui` | surfaces | composes — Muse Get started copy | Unmatched paths are usage and architecture markdown. ### Change flow Get started Muse copy describes the current CLI install path; docs index the same present-tense facts. ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant appUi as app-ui User->>appUi: open Get started Muse steps appUi-->>User: Muse directory has no Kody connector, use Kody CLI ```
  
--- > [!NOTE] > **Low Risk** > Documentation and onboarding UI copy only; no runtime, API, or schema changes. > > **Overview** > Updates **docs and Get started copy** to describe current behavior in the present tense instead of pending-rollout or historical flake narratives. > > **Muse onboarding** (usage docs, `onboarding-mcp-client-panels.tsx`, warnings, and tests) now states that Muse’s directory **does not list a Kody connector** and directs users to the **Kody CLI**; “pending review” language is removed. > > **Architecture / index docs:** `startup-budget.md` explains preview’s slim worker entry without the old upload-flake story; `webhooks.md` documents **`webhookSyntheticDispatch`** (owner-only MCP smoke test, no credential URL) and extends the non-reveal list; `docs/use/index.md` links **Where agent guidance lives** and points synthetic webhook testing at `webhookSyntheticDispatch`. > > **Comment-only** tweak in `onboarding-mcp-clients.ts` for the Muse CLI path. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 027058e7db68b89bd94d0652f500b7e1de3cc3b3. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

check.contents:
#!/bin/bash
# Check that PR #2596 changes are present:
# 1. Muse onboarding copy uses present tense ("does not list a Kody connector")
# 2. "pending review" language is removed from Muse-related content
# 3. webhookSyntheticDispatch is documented in webhooks.md
# 4. docs/use/index.md links to agent guidance

set -e

ERRORS=0

# Check 1: Muse panel content says "does not list a Kody connector" (present tense)
if ! grep -q "does not list a Kody connector" packages/worker/client/routes/onboarding-mcp-client-panels.tsx; then
    echo "FAIL: onboarding-mcp-client-panels.tsx missing 'does not list a Kody connector'"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
fi

# Check 2: Muse warning also uses present tense
if ! grep -q "Muse's directory does not list a Kody connector" packages/worker/client/routes/onboarding-mcp-client-panels.tsx; then
    echo "FAIL: onboarding-mcp-client-panels.tsx missing Muse warning with 'does not list'"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
fi

# Check 3: No "pending review" language in Muse-related content
if grep -i "pending.review" packages/worker/client/routes/onboarding-mcp-client-panels.tsx; then
    echo "FAIL: onboarding-mcp-client-panels.tsx still contains 'pending review' language"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
fi

# Check 4: docs/use/connect-your-agent.md has present-tense Muse description
if ! grep -q "does not list a Kody connector" docs/use/connect-your-agent.md; then
    echo "FAIL: connect-your-agent.md missing 'does not list a Kody connector'"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
fi

# Check 5: webhookSyntheticDispatch is documented in webhooks.md
if ! grep -q "webhookSyntheticDispatch" docs/contributing/architecture/webhooks.md; then
    echo "FAIL: webhooks.md missing 'webhookSyntheticDispatch'"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
fi

# Check 6: webhookSyntheticDispatch is described as owner-only
if ! grep -q "Owner-only" docs/contributing/architecture/webhooks.md; then
    echo "FAIL: webhooks.md missing 'Owner-only' for webhookSyntheticDispatch"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
fi

# Check 7: docs/use/index.md links to agent guidance
if ! grep -q "agent-guidance" docs/use/index.md; then
    echo "FAIL: index.md missing link to agent-guidance"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
fi

# Check 8: onboarding-mcp-clients.ts has the correct comment about Muse CLI path
if ! grep -q "Muse's directory does not list a Kody connector" packages/worker/universal/onboarding-mcp-clients.ts; then
    echo "FAIL: onboarding-mcp-clients.ts missing comment about Muse directory"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
fi

# Check 9: startup-budget.md describes slim preview entry (present tense)
if ! grep -q "slim origin entry" docs/contributing/architecture/startup-budget.md; then
    echo "FAIL: startup-budget.md missing 'slim origin entry' description"
    ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
fi

if [ $ERRORS -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "$ERRORS check(s) failed"
    exit 1
fi

echo "All checks passed"
exit 0
